_what: The published vocabularies' version (OWL evaluation Phase 0, Doug 2026-10-13: 'Version and date'). One version for all three, /ns/meaning, /ns/structure and /ns/relation. The dated copy of each is kept forever at /ns/<name>/<date> (out/ns/versions/). Rule: a term's address never changes; a changed meaning gets a new term and the old one is deprecated. Additions bump the minor version, a change of meaning the major.

license._what: Doug, 2026-10-15: 'go with CC BY 4.0' for the vocabularies, as for the graph (2026-10-10). Granted only once the copyright filing is received: a licence that lets the public download copies publishes the work, and the filing registers it unpublished. To grant: set granted to true, give the release a new version and date, add the same two lines to ontology/meaning/meaning.ttl and ontology/claim/claim.ttl by hand (tools/ns_freeze.py refuses until they match), then run the release (docs/OPERATIONS.md, the /ns release procedure).

data._what: The graph's own version: the exports in out/export/ (claims, entities, ties, card words), apart from the vocabularies' above (the code review, 2026-10-22, B3, approved by Doug: two different builds of the claims carried the vocabulary's 1.2.0 and date, so they could not be told apart). A date-shaped version, set whenever a build is published: at the cut, and with any push that changes what an export says. tools/export_void.py writes it as the datasets' dcat:version and dcterms:modified.

graph_license._what: The graph's licence (the exports in out/export/), decided 2026-10-21 (plan 8.3a): CC BY 4.0, granted for the graph at the cut. Set granted to true on the day the public repository is published, set "repository" (top level) to its address, and rebuild the exports (tools/export_claims.py, tools/export_entities.py, tools/export_card_words.py, tools/export_ties.py, then tools/export_void.py): their headers and the VoID/DCAT description then say the licence, and each distribution names its download address. LICENSE-DATA says the same in the public repository.

_history.1.2.0: 2026-10-21: the reviewed release (plan 8.1e; three committee sittings, 2026-10-19 and 2026-10-20): 110 terms added, none removed or deprecated (structure +46: the prepositional relations, Generic, Together, List; relation +2: spoke_to, states; meaning +18: the filter as data, CardWord, Tie, Tier and the DQV metrics and policy; claim +44: the verb statements' modality and family schemes, clause, evidencedBy). /ns/alignment (SKOS mappings) and /ns/map (the schema as pictures) begin with it. Release run prepared by Claude on 2026-10-20, dated for Doug's push
_history.1.2.1: 2026-10-22: no term added, removed or deprecated, so a patch (as 1.1.1 was). The claim vocabulary's definitions corrected to what the export does after plan 8.3f: the narrator's claims are what the text states or entails; conjectures, disputed claims and the graph's groupings are the editors', described and never stated; no bor:states triple is stated. The two shapes files and /ns/word given their rights and licence (the code review before the public repository; B4, approved by Doug: 'I approve the recommendations')
